experiment: 15N R1, R2 and 1H-15N heteronuclear NOE at 500 MHz
buffer: 10 mM sodium phosphate, 10% (v/v) D2O, TSP-d4 reference
construct_or_mutation: murine vWFA2 subdomain of type VII collagen, residues 1048-1238, untagged after intein cleavage
other_conditions: regime (authors): nanosecond to picosecond local flexibility; related structures: 6S4C (crystal structure from this paper)
timescale: local flexibility at the nanoseconds to picoseconds time scale (R1, R2, NOE; no model-free fit)
author_claim: Two regions show higher flexibility than the bulk: N1133 and residues around A1205/T1208, both in loops; the termini are also flexible.
anchor: Heteronuclear NOEs are markedly decreased for residues N1133 and T1208. This is indicating local flexibility at the nanoseconds to picoseconds time scale
locator: Results, Dynamic behaviour of murine vWFA2 (Fig. 2F, Fig. S4); conditions: Methods, backbone dynamics
caveat_note: Temperature, field, pH match the deposit card (298 K, 500 MHz, pH 7.4); the card lists potassium phosphate for the main sample while the paper states sodium phosphate. Concentration of the relaxation sample is not stated. Per-residue R1, R2, NOE values are in Fig. S4 (figure only).

experiment: 1H-15N residual dipolar couplings (IPAP-HSQC) at 500 MHz compared with the crystal structure
buffer: 10 mM sodium phosphate, 10% (v/v) D2O, TSP-d4 reference
ligand_or_partner: alignment media: PEG-hexanol (4.2% (w/v) PEG) or PEG-hexanol with CTAB (1 : 30 CTAB : PEG-hexanol)
author_claim: RDCs of secondary-structure residues fit the crystal structure; loop outliers fit better when excluded, indicating different loop conformations (and flexibility) in solution than in the crystal.
anchor: Excluding these residues from the analysis improves the fits substantially, indicating a different conformation in the loop structures (as well as reflecting flexibility) in solution state than in the crystal state for these residues.
locator: Results, Crystallization and measurement of RDC of murine vWFA2; conditions: Methods
caveat_note: The first seven residues are outliers in PEG-hexanol (D1114, S1131, V1166, E1199, L1204, A1205, A1233) and the last five in CTAB:PEG-hexanol (L1087, N1133, G1185, E1199, L1204); E1199 and L1204 occur in both. Outliers can also reflect crystal packing or an inexact alignment-tensor fit; the paper gives no timescale.
